about_short: Country songwriter from Northglenn, CO, raised in southern Iowa.
about_bio: ZWrld is the music of a country songwriter living in Northglenn, Colorado, who grew up in southern Iowa. The songs come from where he's from: small towns, long highways, and the people who raised him.

latest_release.title: I Still Miss You
latest_release.blurb: A song about missing someone who's gone.
